credits.title: Pecadora
credits.overview: Isabel is a very religious young woman whose life is transformed when she starts working with Enrico, a free-spirited and seductive man. As she tries to deny her attraction to her colleague and the awakening of her most forbidden desires, she finds herself confronting everything she always believed.

credits.title: Até a Noite Terminar
credits.overview: Tom and Alice decide to strengthen their marriage in a romantic cottage, but the road holds surprises and they will depend on the help of the mysterious Senhora H. As the night goes on, the secrets of this marriage are revealed and the only hope of survival for the couple will be to embrace their own madness.
